data.title: Smith+Nephew Appoints Nick Alexos As CFO
data.description:
LONDON (dpa-AFX) - Smith & Nephew plc (SN.L), a medical technology business, Monday announced that it has appointed Nick Alexos as its Chief Financial Officer, effective November 30.

Alexos has more than 35 years of financial, commercial and transaction experience and was most recently, finance chief at Univar Solutions, a distributor of chemicals and ingredients from 2020 till 2026.

Prior to this, he was the Chief Financial Officer and Chief Administrative Officer of dental technology business Dentsply Sirona. Prior to Dentsply Sirona, Nick spent 30 years at private equity firm Madison Dearborn Partners.

On Friday, shares closed at 1145 pence, up 0.88% on the London Stock Exchange.

data.title: Barrick recommends rejecting NYSB's $26.40-per-share mini-tender offer
data.description:
Barrick Mining (B) on Friday urged shareholders to reject an unsolicited mini-tender offer from New York Stock and Bond LLC to buy up to 50K shares at $26.40 apiece, saying the price is significantly below market value.

Barrick said the offer price represents a 34.91% discount to its November 6, 2026, NYSE closing price, the last trading day before the offer commenced.

The gold miner cautioned that the proposal is subject to numerous conditions and said it does not endorse the offer or have any affiliation with NYSB.

Shareholders who have already tendered their shares may withdraw them within 14 days after delivering their acceptance forms to the depositary, under NYSB's offer documents.

data.title: TotalEnergies deepens U.S. gas tie-up with Continental, eyes 850 MMscf/d U.S. gas output by 2032
data.description:
Key points:
  • TotalEnergies has signed a new agreement with Continental Resources, under which TotalEnergies acquires interests in natural gas upstream assets. The transaction is expected to add approximately 150 MMscf/d1 (equivalent to around 26 kboe/d) to TotalEnergies’ net gas production in the United States by 2032.
  • “This transaction will strengthen our natural gas production in the United States and consolidate TotalEnergies’ integrated position from upstream gas production to LNG exports,” said Nicolas Terraz, President of Exploration & Production at TotalEnergies .
  • The transaction with Continental Resources builds on previous acquisitions of non-operated interests completed in 2025 in the Anadarko Basin with Continental Resources and in 2024 in the Eagle Ford play with EOG Resources and Lewis Energy.
  • These assets will offer low-cost, low-emission, long-plateau production and are well connected to existing midstream infrastructure. Together with TotalEnergies’ operated Barnett asset, they are expected to bring the company’s overall net natural gas production in the U.S. to approximately 850 MMscf/d2 (equivalent to more than 140 kboe/d) from 2032 onwards.
  • TotalEnergies has invested in a number of major LNG projects in the U.S. including Cameron LNG and Rio Grande LNG. TotalEnergies also off-takes LNG from major U.S. terminals, such as Sabine Pass LNG, Freeport LNG, and Corpus Christi LNG.

data.title: Alzinova announces successful QC release of ALZ-101 for Phase 2a ADVANCE study
data.description:
Alzinova AB (“Alzinova” or the “Company”) today announces that the drug product batch for its therapeutic vaccine ALZ-101 has successfully completed quality control (QC) release testing for the upcoming Phase 2a ADVANCE study in patients with early Alzheimer's disease. The milestone marks an important step in the manufacturing preparations ahead of the study.

The QC release confirms that all quality control analyses of the ALZ-101 drug product have been completed in accordance with Good Manufacturing Practice (GMP), and that the batch meets the predefined quality specifications for the ADVANCE study. This represents an important quality milestone in the manufacture of clinical trial material for the ADVANCE study.

Combined with the previously completed manufacturing process optimisation, which enables the production of ALZ-101 in quantities required for Phase 2 clinical trials, this milestone supports Alzinova's preparations for the ADVANCE study. As previously communicated, the Company is targeting enrolment of the first participant around the turn of 2026/2027.

"The successful completion of quality control testing for ALZ-101 marks another important milestone in our preparations for the ADVANCE study. This achievement dramatically reduces manufacturing and clinical supply risks as we prepare to initiate the study, bringing us one step closer to patient enrolment, which remains targeted for around the turn of 2026/2027," comments Tord Labuda, CEO of Alzinova.

For further information, please contact:

Tord Labuda, CEO

E-mail: IR@alzinova.com

About Alzinova

Alzinova AB is a Swedish biopharmaceutical company in clinical development specializing in the treatment of Alzheimer's disease, with a focus on targeting toxic amyloid-beta oligomers. The lead candidate ALZ-101 is a therapeutic vaccine against Alzheimer's disease. Alzinova's patented AβCC peptide technology makes it possible to develop disease-modifying treatments that target the toxic amyloid-beta oligomers that are central to the onset and development of the disease with great accuracy. From a global perspective, Alzheimer's disease is one of the most common and devastating neurological diseases, with around 40 million people affected today. Based on the same technology, the company is also developing the antibody ALZ-201, which is currently in preclinical development, as well as the diagnostic project ALZ-401, which aims to develop a blood test to identify an increased risk of Alzheimer's disease before symptoms appear. The goal is to further expand the pipeline. The company's Certified Adviser on Nasdaq First North Growth Market is Mangold Fondkommission AB. For more information about Alzinova, please visit: www.alzinova.com

data.title: China's electric truck boom lifts demand for lithium
data.description:
Key points:
  • Chinese e-truck sales rise 45% to 600,000 in January-October
  • E-trucks seen using nearly 7% of global lithium supply this year
  • Lithium prices pressured by oversupply worries, uncertain demand

By Solomon Cefai

Surging electric truck sales in China resulting from higher oil prices are driving demand for lithium, an unexpected bright spot for the battery metal that has been dragged down by market worries of oversupply.

Electric truck sales in China, the biggest market for EVs and the dominant producer of batteries powering them, hit 600,000 in the first 10 months of the year, up 45%, accounting for 30% of sales across truck sizes, according to BofA Global Research.

Growth is strongest for heavy trucks, which have the largest batteries containing the most lithium, with sales up 68% to 262,000 units.

While still small compared with car exports, Chinese heavy electric truck exports more than doubled to 16,823 in the four months after US-Israeli strikes on Iran began on February 28, data from China's General Administration of Customs showed. About half went to South and Southeast Asia, where higher fuel costs strengthened demand for electric vehicles.

Electric trucks globally will use nearly 7% of lithium supply this year and 12% by 2030 — which would be equivalent to demand from up to 11.5 million battery electric cars, YJ Lee, a fund manager at Singapore-based Arcane Green Metal Fund who invests in lithium projects, told Reuters.

China's Contemporary Amperex Technology (CATL) , the world's largest manufacturer of EV and energy storage system batteries, described commercial vehicles as a growth area.

"Following passenger vehicles and energy storage, the next major opportunity lies in the electrification of commercial road transport, especially heavy-duty trucks," CATL said in response to Reuters queries.

UK-based consultancy SFA Oxford has raised its 2026 forecast for lithium demand from heavy-duty EVs by 95% in the last year, said Lakshya Gupta, senior market analyst.

BLEAK LITHIUM MARKET

Still, lithium prices remain weighed down by uncertain demand from energy storage systems. Prices have nearly halved since touching in May their highest level since September 2023, with earlier optimism tempered by patchy installation rates in China and slowing domestic EV sales.

Lithium futures on China's Guangzhou Futures Exchange (GFEX) have fallen as traders bet on a surplus and buyers held off on stocking in anticipation prices would fall further, analysts said.

Expectations for a surplus intensified as new mines and restarts of idled operations added supply after the price rally earlier this year.

The lithium market is notoriously volatile and has been buffeted this year by policy shocks, including Zimbabwe's export curbs and licensing delays at a major Chinese mine, and by on the GFEX.

Chinese buyers are unwilling to "catch the falling knife" in a declining market, Fastmarkets' senior lithium analyst Connor Watts said.

"The Chinese utility and commercial vehicle industry isn't large enough to be singularly supporting lithium prices at this moment," he added.

data.title: Capita's Adolfo Hernandez Steps Down As CEO And Board Member With Immediate Effect
Monte dei Paschi's Board Sends Mixed Signals Over Intesa's $37 Billion Offer
data.description:
By Michael Hennessey

Banca Monte dei Paschi di Siena held back from taking a definitive position on Intesa Sanpaolo's $37 billion takeover offer, ahead of the acceptance period starting later this week.

Monte dei Paschi's board on Saturday gave its official opinion on Intesa's buyout offer and said the proposal is at a fair price.

However, the offer doesn't reflect the value of Monte dei Paschi and its prospects for growth and value creation, the board added.

Each shareholder should assess the transaction independently, the board said as it noted that it wasn't making a recommendation to either accept or reject the offer.

Intesa has offered to buy Monte dei Paschi, which is widely considered to be the world's oldest bank still in operation, for around 33.63 billion euros ($36.89 billion) based on Friday's closing prices. Intesa has a market capitalization of around 102.27 billion euros.

The Monte dei Paschi board said it has taken into account improvements made to Intesa's original offer, but said it still doesn't reflect its growth prospects, particularly after the acquisition of Mediobanca.

The projected synergies from the deal of 2.9 billion euros per year also appear high, Monte dei Paschi said.

Monte dei Paschi had previously been looking to fend off Intesa's offer. However, its plans were upended last month when shareholders overwhelmingly rejected twin bids to buy Banca Generali and Banco BPM, proposed by Chief Executive Officer Luigi Lovaglio in an attempt to thwart the takeover.

Intesa is currently offering 1.25 euros in cash and 1.664 of its shares for each Monte dei Paschi share. The exchange ratio was increased to offset an interim dividend that Intesa plans to pay out.

The acceptance period for Intesa's bid will start on Tuesday and end on Jan. 22, unless it is extended.

data.title: ABB To Acquire Ziehl-Abegg For $2.65 Bln; Expands HVAC And Cooling Portfolio
data.description:
ZURICH (dpa-AFX) - ABB Ltd. (ABBN.SW, ABBNY), a Switzerland-based electrification and automation technology company, on Monday announced that it has signed an agreement to acquire Ziehl-Abegg SE for an enterprise value of $2.65 billion and an equity value of $2.22 billion.

The transaction is expected to close in the second half of 2027.

The company said that the acquisition will add electronically commutated fans and integrated motors to its Motion portfolio of motors and drives.

The deal will also expand the company's offerings for heating, ventilation and air conditioning or HVAC, industrial cooling and thermal management applications.

The company expects Ziehl-Abegg to achieve an Operational EBITA margin broadly in line with its Motion business area average within three years after the transaction closes.

The company also intends to retain Ziehl-Abegg's headquarters in Künzelsau, Germany, and maintain its local manufacturing and research and development presence.

Ziehl-Abegg is a Germany-based manufacturer of high-efficiency fans, electric motors, ventilation and control technology. Its products serve HVAC, data centers, clean rooms, medical technology, industrial processes, agriculture and elevator applications.

Ziehl-Abegg is expected to generate approximately $1.4 billion in revenue in 2026, with an Operational EBITA margin in the mid-single-digit range.

data.title: Stora Enso publishes information brochure on the demerger process and Bergslagets Skogar as a standalone company
data.description:
STORA ENSO OYJ STOCK EXCHANGE RELEASE 23 November 2026 at 9:00 EET

HELSINKI, Finland, Nov. 23, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Stora Enso has published an information brochure providing shareholders with additional information on the demerger process and Bergslagets Skogar as a standalone company.

As announced on 30 October 2026, the Board of Directors of Stora Enso Oyj ("Stora Enso" or the "Company") has approved a demerger plan (the "Demerger Plan") concerning the separation of Stora Enso's Swedish forest assets business through a cross-border partial demerger (the "Demerger"). Under the Demerger Plan, all assets, rights, debts and liabilities relating to, or primarily serving, the Swedish forest assets business would be transferred without a liquidation procedure to Bergslagets Skogar AB ("Bergslagets Skogar"), a Swedish public limited liability company to be incorporated in the Demerger. The Board of Directors of Stora Enso has proposed that the Extraordinary General Meeting, convened for 15 December 2026 (the "EGM") would approve the Demerger Plan and resolve on the Demerger as set out in the Demerger Plan, as well as on the other agenda items set out in the notice convening the EGM.

Stora Enso has today published an information brochure containing additional information for its shareholders on the demerger process and Bergslagets Skogar as a standalone company (the "Information Brochure"). The English-language Information Brochure and its Finnish translation are available on Stora Enso's website at storaenso.com/egm2026.

Overview of Bergslagets Skogar

Bergslagets Skogar would be an independent forest company headquartered in Falun, Sweden, owning and managing approximately 1.22 million hectares of land. Its business would comprise the ownership, management, and development of Stora Enso's forest land in Sweden and related forestry operations, the production of paints and colour pigments, and the management of renewable energy projects. The core commercial activity would be the sale of harvesting rights to industrial customers in the Swedish sawmill and pulp mill industry, complemented by external seedling sales, renewable energy land leases, selected land transactions, and income from land-use rights. Building on its long-term customer arrangements, the business model is designed to preserve long-term forest value while generating recurring cash flows with limited capital expenditure requirements.

Carve-out financial information on Bergslagets Skogar

The Information Brochure includes Bergslagets Skogar's unaudited combined financial statements as at and for the years ended 31 December 2025 and 2024, prepared in accordance with IFRS Accounting Standards as adopted by the EU, and its unaudited condensed combined interim financial information as at and for the nine months ended 30 September 2026, with comparative information for the nine months ended 30 September 2025, prepared in accordance with IAS 34 Interim Financial Reporting. This financial information has not been audited or reviewed by an auditor.

Selected carve-out financial information on Stora Enso

The Information Brochure also includes selected unaudited illustrative financial information for Stora Enso excluding Bergslagets Skogar for the financial year ended 31 December 2025 and the nine months ended 30 September 2026. This information illustrates the hypothetical effects of the Demerger on Stora Enso's consolidated income statements as if the Demerger had occurred on 1 January 2025 (including the September 2025 divestment of approximately 175,000 hectares of Swedish forest land) and 1 January 2026, respectively, and on its consolidated statements of financial position as if the Demerger had occurred on 31 December 2025 and 30 September 2026, respectively.

Completion of the Demerger and first day of trading

The planned date of registration of the completion of the Demerger is 31 March 2027, subject to, among other things, approval by the EGM. Trading in the shares of Bergslagets Skogar on the regulated markets of Nasdaq Stockholm and Nasdaq Helsinki is planned to commence as soon as possible thereafter.

Previous related announcements:

  • 2 November 2026: Notice of the Extraordinary General Meeting of Stora Enso Oyj
  • 30 October 2026: Stora Enso's Board of Directors approves demerger plan to separate Bergslagets Skogar into a new listed company, announcing strategic targets and dividend policy
  • 6 March 2026: Stora Enso presents executive management team for the new forest asset company
  • 8 January 2026: Proposed members to the Board of Directors of the new forest company planned to be separated from Stora Enso

For more information about the demerger, please visit the Demerger info page.

Bergslagets Skogar would be an independent forest company based in the heart of Sweden's forest economy. The company will be focused on creating long-term value from forests for our stakeholders, society and nature. Built on deep expertise based on science and advanced forestry practices, the company will manage its forests as living, evolving systems to support their resilience and productivity over generations. The company will continuously explore new ways for forests to contribute economically, socially and environmentally, from harvest rights and renewable raw materials to recreation, biodiversity and climate benefits, and other ecosystem services. bergslaget.com

Stora Enso is a global leader in renewable materials with a strong focus on packaging. Our purpose is to replace non-renewable materials with renewable solutions. Together with our customers, we design and deliver competitive, high-quality packaging materials and solutions, made from fresh and recycled fibers, accelerating the transition to a circular bioeconomy. Stora Enso has approximately 19,000 employees and our sales in 2025 were EUR 9.3 billion. storaenso.com

data.title: France's 2027 economic growth forecast of 1% at risk of being downgraded, minister says
data.description:
The French government's 2027 economic growth forecast of 1% for 2027 is at risk of being downgraded but the goal of limiting the public deficit to 5% of gross domestic product (GDP) must be maintained, French Finance Minister Roland Lescure said on Monday.

"We are currently updating our figures but it (the forecast) is at risk and the risk is that of a downgrade," Lescure told Franceinfo television, adding the new data will be disclosed in January.

"The objective of 5% public deficit (for 2027) must be kept regardlesss of uncertainties over economic growth. It is non-negotiable."

Lescure also confirmed that President Emmanuel Macron was considering a constitutional reform that would impose stricter controls on public spending as France grapples with mounting debt and persistent budget deficits.
